07/21/2024
Insured reported a rear-end collision at a low-speed intersection. The claimant's attorney has notified us of
representation and asked that all cotnact go through their office.
08/07/2024
Photos from the scene show damage to the rear bumper and trunk area that lines up with the impact described. The
police report confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the collision.
08/08/2024
Repair estimate has been received and the damage pattern is consistent with the reported impact. No prior damage
to the vehicle is known from our records or the prior-claims search.
08/28/2024
Claimant reports a wrist injury and was diagnosed with a fracture. The force of the crash appears consistent with this
type of injury, and no earlier injury to the same area is on file.
11/20/2024
Treatment has continued for somewhat longer than is typical for this injury. Medical records are being requested to
review the treatment timeline and any follow-up visits.
11/30/2024
A neighbor contacted us saying they believe the car already had damage several weeks before the reported date of
loss. This is an unverified recollection and has not been confirmed by any other source.
12/07/2024
The claimant has given the same account of the collision in each conversation so far, including the first call, the
recorded statement, and the follow-up with cuonsel present. No independent witnesses have come forward, so the
account rests on the parties and the physical evidence.
12/10/2024
The driver is listed on the policy, and coverage for the date of loss has been confirmed. Liability questions remain
open pending the review of the photos and the police report.
02/06/2025
File is under review. Next steps include obtaining the complete medical records, following up on the neighbor's
comments, and scheduling a final evaluation of the injury claim with the claimant's attorney.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
